description: This file is a JavaScript plugin module for FooTable v3, a jQuery plugin that manages table state (filtering, paging, sorting) using localStorage. It defines the FooTable.State component, methods for state management, and integrates with FooTable's lifecycle events.

classes.name: FooTable.State
classes.description: A component that manages the saving and restoring of table state (filtering, paging, sorting) via localStorage.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves stored state data for a given key from localStorage.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores state data for a given key into localStorage.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes stored state data for a given key from localStorage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Triggers reading of stored state for all components.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Triggers writing of current state for all components.

methods.name: _uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for the table if no ID is provided.
